The structure of Ba8Mg12Zn2 (reduced formula Ba4Mg6Zn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis using CrystalNN identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ba and Zn each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg environments range from 12 to 13 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.12–3.58 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Ba and Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
